_description: E-047b: the CHINCHILLA-ANCHORED month-block pentad codec, the parallel sibling of f4r2-40M-monthblock (E-047a). Same tensor, same holdout_lon '0,0', same time_block 'month', same patch 1 — the ONLY changes are size: 1024x10 with 8 heads (head_dim 128), d_dec 768, d_z 128. MEASURED PARAMS 126,943,329 (126.943M), from `python3 -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'ml');from model import PixelMAE;m=PixelMAE(n_chan=40,d_model=1024,n_heads=8,n_layers=10,d_z=128,d_dec=768,patch=1,dec_layers=2,k_time=7);print(sum(p.numel() for p in m.parameters()))"` — encoder 125,962,240, decoder 788,737, plus the two E-047 embeddings (time_emb 7x1024, q_time 7x16). That is 1.006x the tensor's own anchor: build_family4 prints 2,524,251,443 observed values, and the Chinchilla-style 20:1 anchor is ~126.2M parameters. HEAD_DIM IS 128, THE CEILING AND NOT OVER IT — #387 died of head_dim 256 at 202M, and the recipe guard is not a substitute for sizing heads on purpose: 8 heads into d_model 1024 is exactly 128, and 16 heads (head_dim 64) is the fallback if attention proves the bottleneck. D_Z 128, NOT 64: a month block compresses ~250 observed cells into one embedding, so at d_z 64 the per-value squeeze is about twice the monthly codec's; 128 relaxes it while staying in the same order as the archive's 64. BATCH 256, NOT 512 — see _provenance for the arithmetic. DISPATCH WITH `resume` EMPTY (fresh codec; a recipe cannot pin resume). 126 GB BOX. Design, falsifiers and cost: ml/plans/E047_block_codec.md.
_provenance: Copied field for field from ml/recipes/f4r2-40M-monthblock.json (E-047a), changing only codec_d_model 512->1024, codec_layers 12->10, codec_heads 4->8, codec_d_dec 256->768, d_z 64->128 and batch 512->256. E-047a IS THE CONTROL: it is the same architecture family at ~40M on the same tensor with the same blocks, so the pair answers 'does the month-block idea need the anchor size, or does it pay at 40M too' in one wave instead of two. THE ANCHOR: the tensor reports 2,524,251,443 observed values; at the ~20 values per parameter this programme has been using that is ~126.2M, and the geometry above lands at 126.943M (1.006x) with head_dim at its 128 ceiling. BATCH 256 IS AN ESTIMATE, NOT A MEASUREMENT, and it is the one field here most likely to want changing after the first log window: a month block is 7x40+2 = 282 encoder tokens against the per-bin codec's 42, and this arm is also 2x as wide, so the activation memory per SAMPLE is roughly 13x E-047a's at the same batch. The FFN activations alone at batch 512 are about 512 x 282 x 4096 x 4 B = 2.4 GB per layer, and ten layers held for backward do not fit a 24 GB card; 256 halves that to ~11.8 GB and leaves room for the attention and the optimiser state. If the first steps show headroom, 384 is the next rung — raise it deliberately and say so in the doc, do not let it drift. NOTHING HAS BEEN RUN AT THIS CONFIGURATION YET; this recipe is the dispatch surface and its _provenance becomes a measurement when the run lands.
